signals.title: -90% below trend AND fear at 12
signals.detail: Deep in the Fire Sale band (-90% vs the power-law fair value $2.846) with Fear & Greed at 12. Valuation and sentiment bottoming together.
signals.framing: Where value and fear overlap — historically the account's best-resonating zone.

signals.title: Holders ~40% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.6: price is 40% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.472). Yet 55% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has slipped 0.81→0.6 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

signals.title: NUPL -0.67 — capitulation
signals.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.67 (from MVRV 0.6) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
signals.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
signals.note: A position read, not a signal.
